create_video_processor_sam2: create a Sam2VideoVideoProcessor instance for preprocessing video frames with 1024x1024 resizing and normalization
preprocess_videos_sam2: preprocess a batch of video tensors by resizing to 1024x1024, normalizing with ImageNet stats, and returning batch feature with original and reshaped sizes
post_process_masks_sam2: post-process batched segmentation masks by removing padding, upscaling to original image size, and optionally binarizing with a threshold
build_video_batch_feature: build a BatchFeature object containing pixel values, original sizes, and reshaped input sizes for a batch of video tensors
test_video_processor_pipeline: test the video processing pipeline by preprocessing video tensors and post-processing the resulting segmentation masks
